title: RestorerMod
body:
# RestorerMod



A magical restoration mod that turns the tide of **corruption and decay in your Minecraft world**! 

Bring balance back to nature and resources with powerful alchemy.

## Key Features

### Reverse Corruption

Restore cooked meats back to their raw state using the **Restoration Core**.

Surround raw meats with the Restoration Core to transform them into Corresponding Mob Spawn Eggs.

Unleash your creativity in farming or combat!

### Coral Restoration

Revive dead coral blocks into vibrant, living coral using the Restoration Core. Rebuild your underwater ecosystems!

## Bonus with **Defile** (Optional)

If **Defile** is **installed**, unlock exclusive crafting recipes like transforming items from DefileMod using the Restoration Core.

## Clean & Safe

No crashes if **Defile** is missing. The mod works seamlessly with or without it.

# Setup

**Required Dependency**: **Fabric API** (https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)

Optional Dependency: **DefileMod** (https://modrinth.com/mod/defile)
